text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I don't... want this to end...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Do I want to go back?
...But...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Even if I go back, won't I just repeat the same mistake? Won't I just hit my limit again? That's right. I'm already...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I-I have to... find the words,
scream them, let them all out—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Something, anything...!
What——... what?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...
I couldn't say... a single thing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pitter-patter-pitter-patter...!*)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Oh my... what a coincidence!
Fancy meeting you here.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a terrible expression. We match, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I was bested by her
in the Oka Sho as well."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a 0.1-second difference.
Unbelievable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If we had lost by a huge margin,
it would be much easier to give up, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"And you?
You came here to shout as well, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: W-Why—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I run around here from time to time.
Don't worry, I haven't told my sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I quite like that "You idiot!" of yours.
Because I can feel your indomitable spirit in it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......
Indomitable? An Umamusume like that is...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Then why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"What brought you all the way out here,
climbing this long hill so far from the academy?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I am—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (............A sore loser.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(You realized you couldn't end it yet, right?
You came because that was driven home to you.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Isn't that right? Then, if that's the case—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Hurry up and brace yourself...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: V-Verxina-san...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I came here to take a step forward.
And to do that, there's something I need to tell you first!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry! I was thinking
such awful things about you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you constantly cling on without ever changing,
seeing that side of you that should have made me happy like a comrade—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I hated it. It annoyed me so much. Because... ngh,
it felt like I was the one being blamed...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's so unfair of me, right?
You were just trying your best!
For me to say something like this to you—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So... *sob*, I'm so sorry!
Please don't forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Truth is, I still can't trust myself. I can't forgive myself, and I'm full of anxiety—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I never want to go back to those days... where all I did was struggle fruitlessly...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still... ngh,
as expected—not yet... ngh, not yet...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You huge idiーーーot!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
See, it goes like this.
Yours, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ha.
Haha... haha...! *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-You...
Y-You total idiot...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
I'm such an idioooot!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, damn it, damn it all!
...Like hell I'm gonna give up now!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre, you...
YOU HUGE IDIOOOOOT!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival had ended,
and the equipment was just about packed away—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late.
I'm home.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me run.
...I remembered, clearly. So—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you're willing,
please walk beside me once again...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter how impossible it is, even if in everyone's eyes
the protagonist will always, always be Orfe—
no matter how many people wish for that...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I...
I just really want to surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Seeing her clench her teeth like that, I suddenly remembered what drew me to accept her scouting offer in the first place.
choice_data_list: I've been waiting all this time for the day you steal the spotlight.
I've been waiting all this time for the day you steal the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Of course. Let's keep giving it our all together, as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, I'm sorry.
Um... I was being such an idiot...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Even though you stayed by my side the whole time, I went and made a fool of myself...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep doing my best from now on.
Together... with you!
I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I firmly squeeze back Win Variation's hand, which was surprisingly freezing cold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in the darkened Trainer's room,
the two of us vowed to make a fresh start.
